subject: Next step: reserve dedicated sizing slot & prep checklist for LumenX
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Lopez <alex@lumenx.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + next step: sizing call for dedicated pool

Alex — great to meet earlier. Short recap and proposed next step so we keep momentum: 

- Discovery highlights: LumenX plans to route the inference path for summary + classification for customer support workflows (mixed short/long inputs). Expected average request length ~450 tokens, with occasional long context up to ~4k tokens.
- Targets you mentioned: p95 latency <200ms for short paths, sustained throughput during peak batch windows ~600 requests/min with peaks up to ~2k requests/min for short bursts.

Next step (ask): schedule a dedicated capacity sizing call (30–45m) where Ben (solutions lead) and Karthik (performance SE) will walk your SRE/backend lead through throughput assumptions, telemetry needs, and a provisional pool sizing.

Proposed attendees from our side: Ben Carter (solutions), Karthik Iyer (SE). From your side: Alex, your SRE (Samantha?), and one engineer who owns the API gateway.

Can you share a couple of 45-minute slots that work next week (including time zone)? If helpful, we can propose times. I attached a brief throughput template you can fill out before the call to accelerate sizing.

Attachments: throughput_template.csv (CSV template)

Thanks — Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Lopez <alex@lumenx.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Reed <samantha@lumenx.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next step: sizing call for dedicated pool

Thanks, Tessa — super helpful recap. Samantha will join as our SRE lead and I'm looping her in. A few clarifications from our side before we lock time: 

- Average payload is around 350–500 tokens; summary outputs average ~120 tokens.
- Peak bursts are often tied to bulk processing jobs we trigger nightly; those can be sustained for 5–10 minutes.
- We do care about cold-start behavior (we're sensitive to p99 tail).

We'd prefer the call next week. Samantha's calendar is open Tue/Wed afternoons (PDT). Tue 10/05 2:00–2:45pm PDT looks good for us — does that slot work for your team?

— Alex
Alex Lopez | Head of Engineering, LumenX

- 10–15m workload profile walk-through (you) + confirm peak/avg/long-tail patterns
- 10–15m preliminary pool sizing and autoscale knobs (Redwood)

Pre-call ask: please share the filled throughput_template.csv and a link to any API rate-limit docs you have.

Attachments: 
- throughput_template.csv (helpful to pre-fill)
- MA_plan_draft.pdf (draft mutual action plan we can refine after the call)

If that agenda looks good Ill send a calendar invite for Tue 10/05 14:00–14:45 PDT (30–45m) and include a short pre-read.

Thanks — Tessa
